settings.title: Easy to connect: Plug & Play design
settings.text: Hot Step Snow Melting Mats are designed with easy-to-use male and female connectors, allowing you to daisy chain mats together and create custom pathways. Unlike other mats, our connectors snap together effortlessly, even in cold conditions or with gloves on.

settings.title: High-Efficiency Snow Removal
settings.text: Our mats can melt 1.5 to 2.5 inches of snow per hour. However, performance depends on factors such as pre-existing snow or ice and the ambient temperature.

settings.title: Energy-Efficient
settings.text: With the advanced heating film technology, our mats are about 20% more energy-efficient than other snow melting mats. They melt snow faster at the same wattage, meaning you’ll save around 20% on electricity compared to less efficient options.

settings.title: Top Features of Hot Step Snow Melting Mats
Robust Weatherproof Design
settings.text: Hot Step Snow Melting mats are waterproof and made to withstand harsh weather. Constructed from heavy-duty rubber and equipped with watertight electrical connections, they’re safe to use outdoors, even in rain and snow, all winter long.

settings.title: Durable with Heavy-Duty Load Capacity
settings.text: Hot Step Snow Melting Mats feature a durable, heavy-duty rubber construction with an enclosed heating film, making them strong enough to to handle the weight of cars being driven over them.

settings.title: anti-slip & fall
settings.text: Our mats are specifically designed for stairs and other uneven surfaces, reducing the risk of dangerous slips and falls.
